description: Set the highest operating mode tasks in this workspace may request. A task above the ceiling is refused.

new_ceiling.description: The highest mode tasks in this workspace may request from now on. Existing tasks keep the mode they were created with. Where the coordinator is configured to enforce step-up authentication this method is one of the privileged ones and a call without step-up is refused with -32402.

reason.description: Why the ceiling is being changed. Recorded in the audit entry.
